channel.title: PatinaHall Updates
channel.description: Official, dated updates from PatinaHall — a marketplace for vintage furniture, antiques, design objects, and independent stores.

item.title: Nordlys Retro Hygge joins PatinaHall
item.description: A shop in Denmark has joined PatinaHall, with more than eighty pieces now on its own shop page. Its catalogue came in from its Etsy shop — the first time we have brought one in that way.

item.title: PatinaHall's 325 buying guides are now available in Dutch and German
item.description: All 325 guides are published in English, Dutch and German, each language at its own address. The first French guides are live, with a language control that keeps your choice as you browse.

item.title: Five new guides to choosing and living with vintage furniture
item.description: Visible joints, several lamps in one room, an old picture frame, second-hand curtains, and furnishing a rental you will move out of. Published in English, Dutch and German.

item.title: Preparing for payments: fees, delivery and seller payouts explained
item.description: Planned, not yet available. PatinaHall does not take payment for a piece today. This is the written explanation of how it will work, published before the feature so sellers can read it in advance.

item.title: 60 new stories about Dutch furniture and designers
item.description: Forty-five objects and fifteen designer profiles, from Rietveld's chair made of packing boards to a seat printed in one thick line of reclaimed plastic. All sixty in English, Dutch and German.

item.title: What's next: furniture stories on listings, and alerts for pieces you want
item.description: Two committed pieces of work. Listings will link to the object history and buying guide that apply to them, and you will be able to ask to be told when a piece you want appears.

item.title: Inside the Entourage Finds collection: sculptural metal and detailed antiques
item.description: A closer look at Entourage Finds on PatinaHall — a collection that moves between periods and design traditions, from sculptural metal seating to richly detailed antique furniture.

item.title: The first PatinaHall guide can now be read in German
item.description: PatinaHall is starting to speak more than English. The first guide is readable in German at its own address, and a complete Dutch Furniture Library is being read through before publication.

item.title: PatinaHall can now bring in nopCommerce catalogues
item.description: Vintage furniture shops running a nopCommerce storefront can now bring their existing catalogue and product photography into PatinaHall, while the original shop stays the source.

item.title: Sixty new Furniture Library stories, from the Bureau du Roi to a Hoosier cabinet
item.description: Sixty new articles have joined the PatinaHall Furniture Library, bringing it to 241 stories about the objects, rooms and workshops behind the furniture people live with.

item.title: Every PatinaHall store now introduces the people behind it
item.description: Every store in the PatinaHall directory now has a published profile: a portrait, a logo and a personal introduction from the people who find, repair and sell the furniture.

item.title: PatinaHall Guides have grown to 320 practical answers
item.description: The PatinaHall Guides now cover 320 practical questions about buying vintage furniture: condition, measurements, delivery, materials, repairs and what to ask a seller before paying.

item.title: A Viking toolbox, Darwin’s chair and eight more stories
item.description: Ten new Furniture Library stories follow ingenious objects and the people behind them, from milk-protein inlay to a cupboard that comes out to play.

item.title: PatinaHall Guides gets a new look
item.description: Our 138 Guides now have illustrated previews, nine topic sections and more useful connections between articles, from checking a chair to working out what repairs might cost.

item.title: Nord Vintage’s finds are now on PatinaHall
item.description: A new friendship has brought more furniture to explore: discover Nord Vintage’s selection, from an extending rosewood table to teak chairs with newly woven seats.

item.title: New Guides, familiar furniture and a few good stories
item.description: Practical help for a table that extends, the story behind a familiar sofa, and a trolley with swinging trays: there is more to read in PatinaHall’s Guides and Furniture Library.

item.title: Five chairs that refuse to sit quietly
item.description: Five new Furniture Library stories follow chairs that dismantle, flex, swivel and carry several thousand years of design history without dropping it.

item.title: Five Guides for avoiding very beautiful surprises
item.description: Five recent PatinaHall Guides help buyers check wall systems, beds, pairs, mirrors and stone tops before enthusiasm starts carrying furniture upstairs.

item.title: PatinaHall Guides: a field manual for finding vintage furniture
item.description: PatinaHall Guides now brings practical advice for inspecting, measuring and choosing one-off vintage furniture into one clearer buyer journey.

item.title: Cabinet 59.108: when luxury follows the eye
item.description: A new PatinaHall artefact story looks at one cabinet from around 1700 and the precise places where its workshop spent, saved and impressed.

item.title: How Thonet Chair No. 14 learned to travel
item.description: A new PatinaHall Furniture Library story explains how bent beech, six wooden parts and compact shipping turned an 1859 café chair into a global design.

item.title: Ten iconic chairs are coming to the PatinaHall catalogue
item.description: PatinaHall is building a researched catalogue of iconic vintage and mid-century furniture, beginning with ten chairs and 70 years of design history.

item.title: Nord Vintage is joining PatinaHall
item.description: We are delighted to welcome Nord Vintage, whose collection is shaped by travelling, looking closely, and choosing vintage pieces one at a time.

item.title: Practical vintage furniture guides are now on PatinaHall
item.description: Explore PatinaHall's practical vintage furniture guides covering condition, measurements, delivery, dining chairs, tables, storage, and lighting.

item.title: PatinaHall can now prepare WooCommerce catalogues
item.description: Vintage furniture and antiques shops using WooCommerce can now bring their existing catalogue into a private PatinaHall workspace and keep product updates under their control.

item.title: PatinaHall can now prepare Shopify catalogues
item.description: Vintage furniture and antiques shops using Shopify can now bring their existing catalogue into a private PatinaHall workspace without rebuilding every listing.

item.title: Entourage Finds is now featured on PatinaHall
item.description: A dedicated Entourage Finds Store page now brings its current furniture and object selection together on PatinaHall.

item.title: PatinaHall is live
item.description: The first public version of PatinaHall is now open for discovering vintage furniture, antiques, independent stores, and practical buying guides.
